summary: A 60-day U.S.-Iran ceasefire expired this week with no deal in sight, and Tehran signaled it may shift to an offensive posture and escalate in the Strait of Hormuz, keeping geopolitical risk bid across safe havens. Separately, a cooler-than-expected CPI print dampened Fed hike expectations, fueling the gold surge and softening the dollar — with September hike odds falling to roughly 35%, down sharply from the mid-50s a fortnight ago.
